flowTitle.text: Mole Mayhem AR — core player flow

direction.text: Look: "Sunny Park Arcade". Meadow-green ground (#E9F8D6) with white cards, sky blue (#BFE6FF) and a dirt-patch board outdoors, mallet orange (#FF7A1A) for anything you press or score, grass green (#8EDB3F) for ready / safe / go, forest-green text (#1F3A12). Lilita One for shouty game words, Nunito for everything else. Buttons sit on a solid 6–8 px drop edge so they feel like arcade buttons, and every hit gets a haptic + sound + a BONK burst.

hud.text: HUD rule: the AR camera view is the star. HUD lives in the top 120 px and bottom 140 px only, the centre stays clear except for the reticle. Scores are colour-coded per player and match each player's ring in AR.

safety.text: Safety is part of the fun, not a wall of text: a 20-second swing check before every session, a short chop gesture, and a one-tap switch to tap mode on any screen.
